prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair wearing a white crop top and light purple pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09", "P10", "P11", "P12"].

message.content: {"matches":["P05"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P05 clearly has long dark hair and is wearing a white crop top with light purple pants. All other individuals either have different hair color/length, different top color (e.g., purple or white long-sleeve), or different bottoms (e.g., skirts, shorts, or darker purple pants). No other person matches all three attributes: long dark hair, white crop top, and light purple pants."}

parsed.reason: P05 clearly has long dark hair and is wearing a white crop top with light purple pants. All other individuals either have different hair color/length, different top color (e.g., purple or white long-sleeve), or different bottoms (e.g., skirts, shorts, or darker purple pants). No other person matches all three attributes: long dark hair, white crop top, and light purple pants.
